title: labor gains 2026 09 07
text:
Watch and follow on Apple and Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.

A blowout U.S. jobs report for August keeps pressure on the Fed ahead of Friday's CPI print and a rate decision next week. meanwhile, the ECB is set to hike on Thursday, diesel hits record highs, and a far-right party is on the cusp of taking power in a German state for the first time since World War 2.
